text: Let me ask the car what it knows.
Warning light on with one stored code. Reading it.
A cylinder 1 misfire. Counting misfires per cylinder to see if it's only that one.

summary: One cylinder is misfiring and the light is flashing, so unburned fuel is reaching the exhaust. The cheapest test is to swap the coils on cylinders 1 and 2: if the misfire moves, it's the coil.

text: Cheapest test first: swap two coils. It costs nothing and tells the coil from the plug.

spec.title: swap the coils on cylinders 1 and 2
